research.summary: An ivory fox waits beside the unfinished end of a stair. Inspired by live imaging of adult mouse cortex under chronic hypoxia: microglial processes near growing capillary sprouts were associated with successful connections, and a representative sequence showed them withdrawing after the new vessel stabilized. The precise supporting mechanism remains unresolved. Conceptual art, not a depiction of anatomy.
